Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot and reported right
knee pain with difficulty bearing weight. Over the course of nineteen visits, care
consisted of physical examination, imaging review, a structured rehabilitation
program, and activity modification. The patient followed the recommended plan
consistently, and treatment intensity was gradually reduced as symptoms improved and
range of motion returned. Several examination findings, including localized tenderness
and a positive effusion sign, are consistent with a soft tissue knee injury. Other
orthopedic and ligamentous tests were within normal limits. No prior copmlaints or
treatment involving the same knee were reported or identified in the available
history. Billing records reflect the services rendered without duplicate or repeated
charges for the same procedures. Given the low-speed nature of the impact, the
severity of the reported symptoms at initial presentation is noted for the reviewing
team's consideration. Discharge from active care was planned once the patient reached
functional goals, with home exercise instructions provided.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
